profile: Actual BTCUSDC aggregate executed quantities in fixed 50-USDC price bins; top five separated smoothed peaks, each zone peak +/- one bin. Full 15m buckets with one-minute delay; current UTC session, rolling 1/7/60 days, latest confirmed 4h swing anchor. Two following 4h bars must finish before recognizing swing; anchor starts at original swing bar open, known only after confirmation. Overlapping periods are not independent evidence.
direction: 4h close versus EMA20 and two-bar EMA slope establish initial flow. Daily/1h/15m agreement adjusts sizing quality, never unanimous entry gate. One-hour consecutive closes beyond fixed thesis profile invalidate campaign; tiny opposite reaction reduces inventory instead of flipping. No maximum holding time; sample end still liquidates.
controller: Risk-based variable additions: quality combines profile overlap and context agreement. Tranche estimated risk 0.1%+0.3%*quality of current equity; tranche margin 5%+15%*quality. Aggregate campaign estimated loss allowance 1% of entry cash includes realized losses and remaining position loss at thesis edge; aggregate new-add margin cap60%. These are researcher assumptions and not guaranteed actual stop losses: hourly invalidation can execute beyond edge. Reduction fraction25%+35%*margin-load+20%*opposing-flow, bounded25..80%, rounded to lot step. No fixed tenths and no automatic five-to-three rule. v2 preserves one minimum executable lot during tactical/opposing-zone partial reductions while the hourly thesis remains valid. Whole-position exits remain hourly thesis failure, account halt and sample end. This core rule is a researcher assumption, not an exact user-provided parameter.
comparison: 24 accounts: frozen E056 v2 context_timing baseline vs adaptive vs tenth_cap (same dynamic engine, additionally caps each add to10% entry account margin) vs no_add (adaptive initial entry, no increases); each1/3/5 leverage andbase/stress. Same reused August2026. No parameter search.
limitations: Reused historical August 2026, no fresh holdout

Trade volume is not outstanding orderbook liquidity or known holder cost basis
Average-cost PnL; newest allocation tracking inherits E054 pooled remnants
